question: In which sport, Bajrang Punia won a gold medal at the Commonwealth Games 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wrestling**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bajrang Punia** has won his **3rd Commonwealth Games medal **and his **second successive Gold medal in the men’s 65kg category.**
 
• **The Tokyo Olympics bronze medallist **beat **Lachlan McNeil of Canada in the final (9-2).**
 
• He had won **silver in his maiden CWG in 2014 **and then bettered the colour four years ago in **Gold Cost by winning a gold.**

**​** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Commonwealth Games **often referred to as the **Friendly Games, is an international multi-sport event.**
 
• It involves **athletes from the Commonwealth of Nations**.
 
• The event was first held in **1930, and, with the exception of 1942 and 1946**, has taken place every four years since then.
 
• **The 2022 Commonwealth Games** took place at the Alexander Stadium in** Birmingham, England, from 28 July to 8 August 2022.**
 
• **Perry the Bull** is **Birmingham 2022's official mascot.**
 
• **Indian men's hockey team captain Manpreet Singh & shuttler PV Sindhu** were India's flag-bearers for the opening ceremony of the **Commonwealth Games (CWG) 2022.**
